title: %coerceInteger — parse a value to an integer
purpose: Convert a string (or number) to a typed integer.
notes: The output is a true integer (##), so downstream numeric verbs treat it as a number.
A non-numeric input coerces to ##0 rather than raising an error — validate upstream if that matters.

avoid.why: unparseable input silently becomes ##0; there is no error to catch
